response.overview: After a desperate escape through the chaotic streets of Enugu, a young pickpocket finds himself at a quiet riverbank, where he encounters a little girl waiting for her sister to return.  As an unlikely conversation unfolds, their stories begin to reveal unsettling similarities, blurring the lines between life, death and the things we struggle to accept.
response.title: Waiting For My Sister
